widget.instructions: Press Play: the bars show the energy changing form.

steps.text: Work is done when a force moves something along its direction: W = F × d, measured in joules.
Energy is the ability to do work. A raised object has potential energy; a moving one has kinetic energy.
As the pendulum swings down, potential energy becomes kinetic energy; on the way up it changes back.
Without friction the total stays the same: energy changes form but is not used up.
A dropped ball loses height and gains speed: potential energy becomes kinetic energy.
Just before landing almost all the energy is kinetic.

recap.text: Recap: W = F d; PE ↔ KE; total energy is conserved.
